# mcp-ksef-pl

> MCP server for Polish electronic invoicing — KSeF FA(3)/FA(2) and Peppol BIS 3.0/EN 16931

## Docs

- [Overview](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-ksef-pl/): the full README — what this server does, installation, configuration, available tools
- [Tools](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-ksef-pl/tools/): full MCP tool reference
- [Changelog](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-ksef-pl/changelog/): version history
- [Contributing](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-ksef-pl/contributing/): dev setup and PR checklist
- [Security](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-ksef-pl/security/): vulnerability disclosure policy
